title: Cyanotype catalog entry
description: One selectable technology or rule. Editor support only: the tool validates entries with its own Go code, which also checks references across entries. See the catalog section of docs/DESIGN.md.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across the catalog. Must equal the file name without .yaml.

category.description: Group the entry appears in, such as language, framework or agent-safety.

select.description: radio if exclusive within its category, checkbox if cumulative. Exclusivity inside a radio category is implicit.

url.description: Target of the "i" icon. Expected for technologies.

requires.description: Plain ids of entries that must also be selected.

requires_one_of.description: Groups of alternatives, such as [nextjs, vite-react]: each group is satisfied when at least one of its plain ids is selected. A single id belongs in requires.

conflicts.description: Plain ids of incompatible entries in other categories. Must be declared on both sides; never list an entry of the same radio category.

level.description: Lets simple mode prefer beginner-friendly entries.

topic.description: Split file the snippet goes to when output is split, such as testing or tooling.

snippet.description: The rule added to generated files and its reason.

why.description: The reason behind the rule, in short form.

enforce.description: Real constraints generated alongside the snippet.

claude.description: Constraints written to Claude Code settings.

deny.description: Permission rules added to the deny list, such as "Bash(yarn *)". A denied action stays blocked even when the user would approve it.

ask.description: Permission rules added to the ask list, such as "Bash(npm install *)", for rules that mean "ask first": Claude Code asks the user before the action. A rule may not also be in deny, which wins.

with.description: Rules that apply only when another entry, named by the key, is selected too, such as pnpm's install command under dependency-approval. Only ask rules are supported for now.

ask.description: Permission rules added to the ask list when the key's entry is selected.

gitignore.description: Lines for the .gitignore block cyanotype owns, such as ".env", in order: a negation such as "!.env.example" only re-includes what the lines before it ignore. One pattern per line, without leading or trailing spaces and not starting with #.

detect.description: What reveals the entry in an existing project.

files.description: Paths relative to the project root.
